title: fix(muya): cut a cross-block selection from beforeinput too (#5415)
issueTitle: [Bug] Cmd+Backspace across two blocks detaches the second block, and Enter on a list then throws "Failed to execute 'insertBefore'"
why: Every route the report gives is specific to macOS (Cmd+Backspace, macOS Ctrl+K/D/H/Y, the emoji picker or dictation), and it never says whether any Linux key combination triggers the bug; the only visible failure is a renderer error dialog or a saved-file difference, which this setup cannot reliably check.
